sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:7

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:7:1
items.html: The place of judgment, there is wickedness: That is, the judgment of the Sitra Achra, which turns into hard and bitter judgments, in the secret of the verse, “and ordinances, they have not known them.” And with this you will understand the words of the Zohar, Teruma, page 164b: “To the Sitra Achra they give a greater number, yet in its counting it is in deficiency, such as Ashtei Asar [eleven],” etc.; study it there well. And this is the measure of evil, so as to exact payment from the wicked, for they give the Sitra Achra power to cling more than is due them, and thereby “a storm shall fall upon the head of the wicked.” And this is the hint of our sages: “A camel went to seek horns, and the ears it had were cut off from it.” And understand. (Sanhedrin, page 106)
